title: Transport PeerId
description: A libp2p PeerId in its canonical string form. One profile owns exactly one persistent PeerId (ADR-0030); it is the only cryptographic identity in the transport. EndpointId is a routing selector beneath it and is never an identity. The pattern below is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT: the 44 tail characters are a base58btc number whose bytes have a fixed structure — an identity multihash wrapping a libp2p Ed25519 public-key protobuf for the 12D3KooW form, a sha2-256 multihash for the Qm form — and most strings the pattern admits decode to neither. A JSON Schema matches text and cannot express the decode, so an implementation must perform it; validating the pattern alone accepts values every libp2p parser rejects.
